text:
ella: quick micro-sync — i drafted 3 visual options for the launch: 1) scatter (latency ms vs $/1k), 2) stacked waterfall showing cost reductions from batching+cache, 3) small-multiples by use-case (chat/search/rerank). want to pick one hero.

tony: love the small-multiples idea. it helps product folks see direct analogies. but hero should be simple for social. maybe scatter + inset watermark for waterfall.

sam: analytics note: whichever hero we pick, we need a single KPI on the CTA: kit-download -> trial conversion. that should be the primary metric for paid channels.

emily: copy options for A/B test: A) "Lower your token bills without sacrificing responsiveness" B) "Predictable latency for launch-ready features" C) "Tune serving: cut cost, keep UX". propose A vs B in headline test.

ella: agree on A vs B. i'll wire two hero variants and the form. also adding a microcopy line under the hero: "Based on steady-state runs; includes batching & cache effects."

tony: design asks: hero PNG 1200x628, waterfall GIF (loop), and three microcards. can we get a tiny annotation on scatter showing an "SLA band" (dotted box)?

emily: routing rules suggestion: webinar signups with team_size>25 -> AE; kit downloads with company domain -> SDR; all others into nurture drip (3-touch).

sam: also capture 'primary use-case' on form (chat/search/rerank) — use that to seed AE messaging.

ella: i ran a quick slice and put rough numbers below for the scatter. use only for layout mockups.

ella: ```
model,median_ms,cost_per_1k,use_case
redwood-8k,52,0.058,chat
redwood-13b-opt,118,0.074,search
open-13b-q4,88,0.049,rerank
gptx-mini,260,0.135,batch
```

tony: nice. for the waterfall, show baseline cost then reductions: batching -18%, prefix-cache -24%, KV-ttl -5% (approx). put % labels on bars.

emily: webinar hook: "3 levers we used to take a prod search feature from $0.12 to $0.06 per 1k tokens" — 20m demo, 20m customer, 10m q&a. CTA: claim benchmark kit + sample config.

sam: tracking: headline variant, UTM source, kit downloads, trial starts, AE handoffs. create dashboard in Looker for the funnel.

ella: action items: tony -> hero comps (2 variants) by Fri 2pm, emily -> routing rules & form by Thu EOD, sam -> Looker funnel setup by next Tue, i'll produce final CSV for design by Thu noon.

ops-bot: benchmark-artifacts-5312 ready. preview: https://preview.redwood.com/econ/5312/assets :white_check_mark:

ella: ok locking this plan. thanks all — i'll drop the hero copy and the 2 figma links once drafts are up. :sparkles:
